location.description: iphone:// for the only connected device, or iphone://<udid>

device_id.description: UDID of the device to restore to, an alternative to naming it in the location

working_directory.description: Directory the backup is materialized in before being restored; defaults to <user cache dir>/plakar/iphone

confirm.description: Restore onto the device once the backup directory is complete. Without it the directory is written and the command to run is printed.

backup_password.description: Password of an encrypted backup. The BACKUP_PASSWORD environment variable is honoured as well.

restore_settings.description: Restore device settings from the backup

remove_items.description: Remove items on the device that are not in the backup

no_reboot.description: Do not reboot the device after the restore

skip_apps.description: Do not reinstall apps after the restore

pairing_timeout.description: How long to wait for the Trust dialog to be accepted on the device
